title: Invitation replay resurrects revoked enrollment after forced removal
description: Files: groups_collection.py:253-256 (removal pops invitation), :540-549 (join_key leaves entry unconsumed), groups_invite.py:59-66 (POST appends well-formed doc unconditionally against no revocation ledger, no nonce/consumption marker). Repro: removal -> invitation_valid False -> re-post same doc -> True. Replay of previously-accepted doc re-enrolls post-removal. Fix: consumption markers or revocation-checked acceptance.
close_reason: Fixed: consumption markers keyed by stable document identity sha256(canonical cbor of inviter+node+role+expires) (groups_collection._invitation_identity). record_invitation(inviter=...) refuses identities already burned; join_key marks consumed once via consume_invitation and FORBIDDENs consumed-not-member entries; rekey forced removal burns the popped entry's identity. Full replay lifecycle test: test_groups_invite_replay.py::test_invitation_replay_lifecycle_is_rejected_at_every_stage (accept->join->replay declined->removal->replay declined->join denied) and test_unconsumed_invitation_is_burned_by_forced_removal.
